Samsung uses LC in model-dependent leakage or low-water-level conditions; some guides identify detected leakage while others direct users to drain-hose placement.

Stop the washer, check for visible leakage and verify the external drain-hose position in the exact model manual. Dismantle nothing and make no electrical measurements.

steps_json.detail: Pause the programme, wait for the drum to stop and do not force the door.
Photograph the complete display and note the programme stage and exact appliance E-Nr.
Stop the washer, check for visible leakage and verify the external drain-hose position in the exact model manual. Follow every warning in the E-Nr manual.
Test only after correcting an external cause, and never with leakage, burning smell, smoke, abnormal heat, an electrical fault or severe scraping.
Request service if the issue remains or returns; open no panels and test no internal parts.

en.when_to_call_technician_html:

Follow installation and load guidance, empty pockets, dose correctly and keep visible hoses and user-accessible filters clean as the manual specifies.

Keep the washer level; internal component faults cannot be prevented through dismantling.

en.meta_description: Samsung Washer Door Seal Damaged or Mouldy? See verified Samsung causes, safe external checks and when authorised service is required.
en.h1: Samsung Washer Door Seal Damaged or Mouldy
en.description: Samsung recommends regular gentle cleaning and drying for residue or surface mould; a torn, deformed or leaking seal requires service assessment.
en.quick_fix: With the empty washer off, inspect and gently wipe the user-accessible gasket as the model manual specifies; do not run the washer if it is torn, deformed or leaking (about 5–30 minutes).
en.intro_html:
Samsung recommends regular gentle cleaning and drying for residue or surface mould; a torn, deformed or leaking seal requires service assessment.

With the empty washer off, inspect and gently wipe the user-accessible gasket as the model manual specifies; do not run the washer if it is torn, deformed or leaking. Dismantle nothing and make no electrical measurements.

causes_json.cause: Moisture and residue retained in gasket folds
causes_json.detail: This is a possible cause; use only external checks in the exact E-Nr manual.

causes_json.cause: Surface mould from limited drying
causes_json.detail: This is a possible cause; use only external checks in the exact E-Nr manual.

causes_json.cause: Foreign object abrasion or chemical damage
causes_json.detail: This is a possible cause; use only external checks in the exact E-Nr manual.

causes_json.cause: Torn, deformed or leaking door seal
causes_json.detail: This is a possible cause; use only external checks in the exact E-Nr manual.

steps_json.detail: Remove all laundry, switch off and wait for the drum to stop.
For burning smell, smoke, sparks or abnormal heat, isolate power safely, do not run the washer and arrange service.

With the empty washer off, inspect and gently wipe the user-accessible gasket as the model manual specifies; do not run the washer if it is torn, deformed or leaking. Use only products and methods permitted by the model manual.
Dry the gasket and drawer and leave the door and drawer open when safe and the appliance is not in use.
Do not use the washer if the gasket is torn, deformed or leaking, or if odour remains after correct cleaning.

en.when_to_call_technician_html:
Arrange Samsung service if the issue remains after documented external checks or if the pump, valve, door lock, drive, bearing, wiring or electronics are suspected.

Stop immediately for leakage near electricity, burning smell, smoke, sparks, abnormal heat, tripped protection or severe grinding or scraping.
en.prevention_html:
Follow installation and load guidance, empty pockets, dose correctly and keep visible hoses and user-accessible filters clean as the manual specifies.

Keep the washer level; internal component faults cannot be prevented through dismantling.

faq_json.question: Can I keep using the washer?
faq_json.answer: Only if it returns to completely normal operation after a safe external correction and no warning symptom is present.

faq_json.question: Should I open an appliance panel?
faq_json.answer: No. Limit checks to parts the manual explicitly identifies as user-accessible.

faq_json.question: Should I order a replacement part?
faq_json.answer: Not from the symptom alone. Internal faults require diagnosis for the exact E-Nr.

faq_json.question: When is Samsung service required?
faq_json.answer: When the issue remains or returns, or when an internal, electrical, leakage or mechanical fault is suspected.
